scientific_limitations: Only two simple consistently oriented directed cycles, each of length at least three; no classification of all optimal landmark sets, arbitrary orientations, bidirected cycles, or higher products. Earliest verified public motivating chapter appeared 2026-06-07; the expanded arXiv version is later. Historical priority beyond inspected sources remains subject to expert literature review.
